limits: Coarse terrain does not resolve the sharp summit, bastion feet or covered spiral entrance; exact vertical datum, native resolution and vintage remain unverified.

One rigid shift puts the fresh mapped approach start 0.08 m above decoded grade. The existing 30 m relative court height is retained as an explicit reconstruction; independent map elevation tags 825 and 855 are not a connected survey.
Mapped structural skirts extend below sampled terrain. A narrow connected lowest-road and Eagle-gate ground cut clears only owned civil surfaces; upper court and mountain remain host terrain.

inspection.notes: Actually inspected 25 final terrain images after opening the upper-ramp support crossing and closing the bounded excavation with a below-deck floor and inward retaining faces. Both gates and curved lower approach remain usable at all browser levels. The close Eagle camera follows a straight gate axis; the actual approach bends, so a retaining corner enters the right foreground. Explicit mapped-route rays pass. Coarse terrain and interpreted vertical layout remain accepted limits.
